svg.title: Fan-out architecture: Swiggy order placed event fans out to 5 independent services
svg.desc: Order service publishes order.placed to Kafka. Kafka fans out simultaneously to: Notification service, Inventory service, Analytics service, Loyalty/points service, and Fraud detection service. Each has its own database.
svg.text: all 5 run simultaneously — Order service knows nothing about them
key insight — adding a new service
Want to add an email-receipt service? Just subscribe it to order.placed.
Zero changes to Order service. Zero downtime. Pure fan-out.
